checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Training accepts only its own output and registered U_s. Frozen external comparators are opened after both fits; E104 opened for frozen source evaluation only.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Independent scratch fits. Historical 40000-step DURA and 24000-step U-Net are source-evaluation comparators only.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze at step 24000. Candidate half readout must strictly beat all fixed comparison rows on six scenes, match or exceed the strongest low-urban count, and match or exceed direct clean. On pass run all three 30000-packet Full shards and collect independent truth-last scores.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 GPUs 3 and 2. Each starts with one incumbent Python fit and at least 12 GiB free. One new worker per card, at most two training jobs per card. The launcher also caps visible CUDA contexts at strictly below eight per card before admission.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on a systemic technical/protocol failure, incompatible source or frozen comparator, collision, or prediction/scoring failure. Preserve all artifacts. Source scores gate only target eligibility via preregistered paired rules.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent source scorer; E:/type10-7/local_envs/phase1-cu128/Scripts/python.exe -m experiments.pamf_lora_main.w24_third_prior collect-score --chirp-components after the three formal Full shards freeze.
